title: Shared tracer errors restrict unchanged oxygen-use fits on A20 and A22 in 2012-2021 under local renewal
abstract: We tested whether unchanged oxygen-use fits on A20 and A22 depend on independent tracer errors. We fitted GLODAPv2.2023 CFC-12, SF6 and oxygen on sigma0 26.5 in 2012 and 2021 with age spectra linked by aging and young surface input. A linear change of variables allows shared multiplicative tracer factors and common oxygen-use parameters to be fitted together. At A20, a five-year saturating oxygen-use law fits with independent 5% errors, but has a minimum maximum AOU error of 5.986 umol/kg with shared 5% factors and 2% independent noise. A one-year law still fits. Shared factors alone fail the tracer-only local-renewal test at both sections. The exact continuous-age tracer-only minimum independent noise is 1.911-1.914% at A20 and 3.782-3.785% at A22, in addition to shared 5% factors. On the 0.25-year grid, the A20 five-year law needs 2.933-2.936% noise with age-selective removal, or 3.967-3.970% if half the water is retained uniformly. A 0.1-year repeat and independent spectrum audits support the main results. These bounds test specified error and transport models; they do not estimate true errors or identify a ventilation share. Source saturation, age support, old-water imports and oxygen-use laws remain uncertain. Code, aggregate results and retrieval instructions are included. External observations remain outside the bundle.

display.caption: Tracer error sharing changes the A20 fit. Shared factors and independent noise have separate effects. Noise thresholds apply to the stated local-renewal model and age grid.
